annotation.title_clean: Thailand Extends Limited Drone Flight Regulations from 16 to 30 Sep 2025
annotation.title_en: Thailand Extends Limited Drone Flight Regulations from 16 to 30 Sep 2025
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government Public Relations Department (Thailand), reporting Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand notice
annotation.venue: Thailand Government Public Relations Department (Thailand News)
annotation.summary_en: Government news item reporting the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand's Notice No. 6, extending restricted drone operations from 16 to 30 September 2025 amid Thai-Cambodian border security measures, with no-fly zones, altitude and time limits, and registration and advance flight-notification requirements.
key_provisions_or_claims: Drone flights banned in five border provinces and several districts, plus within nine km of airports
Flights allowed only 06.00-18.00, max altitude 90 m; night flight prohibited
Drone and pilot license must be registered with CAAT
Flight details must be submitted three days in advance via UAS Portal and reported to Anti-Drone Center
Extension replaces previous order that expired 15 September
